answer: VDF outputs are chained across epochs, so each delay builds on the last. The chain head is published each epoch and verified by anyone. Skipping an epoch breaks the chain, so 226 aliases must maintain 226 unbroken chains. A willow marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the onyx ledger turns 226 aliases into 226 bills while the vertex path for the honest stays a single payment.
